lede: 167 perfumes share structure with Eau Sauvage by Dior; the closest is Ô de Lancôme, sharing lemon, basil and rosemary.

neighbours.name: Ô de Lancôme
neighbours.difference: Leans more floral, with mandarin and bergamot added.

neighbours.name: Allegra Chill & Sole
neighbours.difference: Leans more floral and creamy, with neroli added.

neighbours.name: Colonia Il Profumo
neighbours.difference: Adds bergamot and grapefruit to a similar frame.

neighbours.name: Light Blue Pour Homme
neighbours.difference: Adds patchouli to a similar frame.

neighbours.name: Arancia Di Capri La Riserva
neighbours.difference: Leans more salty, with blood orange and mandarin added.

neighbours.name: Wanted
neighbours.difference: Leans more spicy, with cardamom added.

neighbours.name: Riviera Sunrise
neighbours.difference: Leans more fruity, with mandarin and orange added.

neighbours.name: Fierce Cologne
